note: The gf2 throughput arms are the 3be770d5 steady-state harness built against the two generations of gf2-coding. `before` is built from an export of the pre-change revision, `after` from the changed tree; their executables therefore live in different target directories, which the plan generator resolves. The AFF3CT throughput arm is the one 3be770d5 measured, unchanged. The two `checknode` arms are the isolated check-node pass of REQ-10's kernel granularity; they live in this issue's own arms workspace, whose target directory is the `kernel` generation, and they read no prepared quality because an isolated pass decodes no frame.

gf2-before-nms-f32.description: gf2-coding LdpcDecoder before 07ca8585: per-edge neighbour search and one leave-one-out reduction per outgoing edge, f32 flooding normalized min-sum, syndrome stopping, one reused decoder per pinned worker

gf2-after-nms-f32.description: gf2-coding LdpcDecoder after 07ca8585: canonical edge layout and one shared minimum, second-minimum and sign reduction per check, f32 flooding normalized min-sum, syndrome stopping, one reused decoder per pinned worker

aff3ct-flooding-nms-f32.description: AFF3CT v4.7.0 Decoder_LDPC_BP_flooding<NMS>, f32, scalar, one clone per pinned worker

gf2-checknode-nms-f32.description: gf2-coding after 07ca8585, one flooding check-node pass over a prepared variable-to-check message array through the canonical EdgeLayout check runs and min_sum_check_row, f32 normalized min-sum, no variable update and no termination in the timed call, one prepared array and one output array per pinned worker

aff3ct-checknode-nms-f32.description: AFF3CT v4.7.0 tools::Update_rule_NMS<float> over the check-node scan order of Decoder_LDPC_BP_flooding::_decode_single_ite, one pass over the same prepared variable-to-check messages in AFF3CT's own variable-major edge order, one pass object per pinned worker
